original: 動物園までは歩いて行けますかね？

en.text: Is the zoo walking distance from here?

original: 裸で学校に行けたらいいなぁ、すっごく快適だろうね！

en.text: I wish I could go to school naked. It'd be so liberating.

original: 病気が治れば、学校へ行けます。

en.text: I can go to school once I recover from my sickness.

original: トムはそこへ行こうと思えば行ける。

en.text: Tom can go there if he wants to.

original: 釣りに行けなくて残念だ。

en.text: It's too bad we're not out fishing.

original: すぐそこだから、歩いて数分で行けるよ。

en.text: It's only a short way, so you can walk there in a few minutes.

original: 残念ですが、ランチのお約束は行けそうにありません。

en.text: I'm afraid I won't be able to make it for our luncheon appointment.

original: 僕はパーティーに行けなかった理由をでっち上げた。

en.text: I concocted an excuse for missing the party.

original: 学校には歩いて10分で行けます。

en.text: I can walk to school in 10 minutes.

original: 車持ってないから行けなかったんだよ。

en.text: We couldn't go there because we didn't have a car.
I don't have a car, so I couldn't go.

original: そこに２時半までには行けるように頑張るよ。

en.text: I'll do my best to be there by 2:30.
I'll do my best to get there by 2:30.
I'll try my best to be there by 2:30.

original: 明日まで待ってくれたら、一緒に行けるんだけど。

en.text: If you wait until tomorrow, I could go with you.
If you could wait until tomorrow, I could go with you.

original: １週間、学校に行けてないんだ。

en.text: I haven't been able to go to school for a week.

original: バスで行けるよ。

en.text: You can get there by bus.

original: トムは、車よりも自転車の方が早く職場に行けるんだ。

en.text: Tom can get to work faster on bicycle than by car.

original: 30分で行けるよ。

en.text: I can be there in thirty minutes.

original: 行けるかな？

en.text: Can I go?

original: 「今日の午後、来れる？」「うん。行けると思う」

en.text: "Can you come over this afternoon?" "Yes, I suppose I could."

original: 明日も行ける。

en.text: I can go tomorrow, too.

original: ちょうど雨も止んだし、行けるね。

en.text: The rain has just stopped. We can go.

original: 歩いて行ける距離ですよ。

en.text: It's within walking distance.

original: 大学には、バスで行けます。

en.text: You can go to university by bus.

original: お、おう、行けたら行くわ。

en.text: Oh, if I can go, I will.

original: 外には行けなかった。

en.text: I couldn't go outside.

original: お前と一緒に行けるよ。

en.text: I can go with you.
